text:
Predicates:
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(y) ::: y is a football club.
Questioned(y) ::: y is Nautico, Braga, Fluminense.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
BornIn(ailton_silva, 1995) ∧ Name(ailton_silva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
Footballer(ailton_silva) ::: Ailton Silva is a footballer.
PlaysFor(ailton_silva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(ailton_silva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ Club(fluimense) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.
LoanedOut(ailton_silva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
Conclusion:
LoanedOut(ailton_silva, y) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to some football club.
